package.description: 2D analysis software for materials characterization and quality control

en-US.description: 2D analysis software for materials characterization and quality control
en-US.longDescription:
Amira-Avizo2D Software provides advanced feature classification and statistics extraction capabilities on 2D images in a low learning curve environment.
Amira-Avizo2D Software allows materials scientists and Quality Control engineers to build and run image analysis ‘recipes’, combining Deep Learning models, pre-built workflows and powerful image processing tools.
en-US.name: Thermo Scientific TM Amira-Avizo 2D Software

zh-CN.description: 用于材料表征和质量控制的二维分析软件
zh-CN.longDescription:
Amira-Avizo2D 软件在易于学习的环境中，为二维图像提供先进的特征分类和统计信息提取功能。
Amira-Avizo2D 软件使材料科学家和质量控制工程师能够构建并运行图像分析“方案”，结合深度学习模型、预设工作流程以及强大的图像处理工具。
